result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_average_degree()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Calculate average degree across all nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L13831-L13866){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_average_degree() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} For directed graphs, this returns the average of (in-degree + out-degree). For undirected graphs, each edge contributes to the degree of both endpoints. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Mean degree value across all nodes. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Calculate average degree: ::: {#3a442663 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "D") .add_edge("D", "A") ) # Returns 2.0 (cycle graph) graph.get_average_degree() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2.0 ``` ::: :::
